name: claude-skills
description: Ian Lawrence personal skill library for investment analysis and deal intelligence

plugins.name: deal-master
plugins.description: Deal workflow entry point: inventories existing work, loads analytical and evidence-control layers, initializes the belief register, and routes IC memo or full new-deal package workflows.

plugins.name: analytical-operating-system
plugins.description: Evidence-control layer for analysis and recommendations: F/E/H claim tagging, belief registers, Bayesian updates, kill triggers, and PROCEED / ADJUST / PASS / RESOLVE FIRST posture.

plugins.name: deal-intelligence
plugins.description: Grouped deal-intelligence plugin with market research, diligence, IC memo, QA, and Pattern DOCX/PPTX production skills.

plugins.name: mckinsey-consultant
plugins.description: Use when a complex problem — strategy, diagnosis, or a decision — needs disciplined structure, not an ad hoc answer. Builds MECE issue trees and Pyramid Principle recommendations.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Vendored copy of obra/superpowers (MIT) — brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, subagent-driven development, and code-review workflows. Kept in-repo so Codex (via AGENTS.md) and other non-Claude harnesses can read these skills directly.
